title: SAFR Reporting Standard: Quarterly Update
description: Canonical quarterly payload for the SAFR Reporting Standard, schema version 1.0 (major version 1). One coherent schema: attestation is a conditional layer within it, not a separate document. When meta.attestation_grade is 2, the attestation object is required; at grade 1 it is absent. Field-level x-tier marks distribution: 'visible' fields flow to the Visibility tier (invitational, need-to-know; never a public listing); 'holder' fields flow to the Holder tier only. The raw ledger never leaves the venture; only this schema-shaped output does, by the venture's standing grant. Calculations are defined in the SAFR Reporting Standard spec; x-canonical-constants below mirrors the controlling numbers for machine use. License: MIT.

manifest_hash.description: Content hash (sha256) of the venture's current Manifest as of this quarter-end, per Reporting Standard Section 7.2. Present if and only if the venture has posted a Manifest. A copy of the Manifest is authentic only if its content matches this hash.

tax_classification.description: The venture's U.S. federal income tax classification as of the quarter-end. 'c_corporation' is the only corporate value: the canonical form is not designed for an S corporation, whose one-class-of-stock rule the characterization in instrument Section 8(j)(i) would put at risk. 'partnership' means any entity so taxed, whatever its form, including a trust or series. Selects the applicable Conversion Declaration exhibit for a Conversion Offer issued with this Update (instrument Section 5(e)), and makes any change of classification visible to every holder in the quarter it occurs. A change of classification alone is not a Change of Economic Control (instrument Section 5(d)(iii)).

elected_schedule.description: The Schedule elected on the first page of the instrument. Fixed for the life of the position and independent of tax_classification: either Schedule may be elected by an entity of either classification. One Schedule per venture: every outstanding position of the venture carries the same election, and an issuer running both Schedules does so through distinct ventures, each with its own venture_id and Feed.

declared_budget_applicable.description: Whether the instrument provides for a Declared Budget in this quarter. Under the SAFR canonical form this is true in any quarter in which an outstanding position has reached its Election Date. A host instrument that provides for a Declared Budget from its first Update sets it true throughout. Asserted by the venture as a fact about its instrument rather than computed from the Feed: no figure in this schema depends on it.

fiscal_quarter_end.description: The fiscal quarter-end this update covers (Mar 31, Jun 30, Sep 30, or Dec 31). The reference data period is the trailing twelve months ending on this date.

issued_at.description: Issuance timestamp; must fall within 45 days after fiscal_quarter_end.

attestation_grade.description: 1 = self-attested conforming Feed; 2 = independent third-party attestation of the Ledger Base computation. Grade 2 is required for all graduations.

reporting_lapse_cured.description: True if this update cures or follows a Reporting Lapse; details in quarter.commentary.

balance.description: Balance inputs at fiscal_quarter_end. Aggregates only; no counterparty identities.

equipment_net.description: Equipment and deployed infrastructure at depreciated cost, including assets committed under Dedicated-Asset Contracts.

monthly_qualified_dev_spend.description: Qualifying product development spend at cost, per Reporting Standard category rules, given as a per-month series sufficient to compute the vintaged Qualified Development Asset. Each month of spend amortizes straight-line over its own 36 months, so the asset equals the sum over entries of amount times max(0, 1 - month_offset/36). At least the trailing 36 months must be supplied; spend with a month_offset of 36 or more contributes nothing.

month_offset.description: Months before the reference period end; 0 is the most recent month. The amortization weight for this month is max(0, 1 - month_offset/36).

amount.description: Qualifying development spend recorded in that month, at cost.

revenue_streams.description: Revenue valued stream by stream for Forward Revenue Value, each stream by exactly one disposition fixed by a two-step mechanical test read in order. Step one, the source test: a stream under a Dedicated-Asset Contract (a signed contract granting a counterparty use of an identified asset, or identified pool of assets, that the venture owns and carries in Tangible Net Assets, with payments made for that use) takes a Forward Revenue Value of zero; the producing asset already carries the position's value at depreciated cost. Step two, the term test, for every other stream: a signed contract whose term at signing is at least contract_term_threshold_months (12) takes the present-value method; every remaining stream takes a quality multiple on its trailing-twelve-month revenue. A stream populates only the value fields its disposition uses; unused value fields are zero. Quality mix is Visible; no customer identities ever.

is_dedicated_asset_contract.description: True if the stream is under a Dedicated-Asset Contract: a signed contract granting a counterparty use of an identified asset, or identified pool of assets, that the venture owns and carries in Tangible Net Assets, with payments made for that use. Leases, rentals, and charters are the common forms. When true, the stream's Forward Revenue Value is zero regardless of the other fields, and the source test overrides the term test. Set at calibration; does not change quarter to quarter.

quality.description: Quality tag for the multiple method: recurring 2.0, repeat 1.0, one_time 0.25. Not used when the dedicated-asset disposition or the present-value method applies.

is_signed_contract.description: True if the stream is under a signed contract. Read at step two, after the source test: a signed contract whose term_at_signing_months is at least contract_term_threshold_months (12), and that is not a Dedicated-Asset Contract, takes the present-value method.

term_at_signing_months.description: Contract term in months as of signing. Compared once against contract_term_threshold_months (12) to fix the disposition at step two; the disposition does not change quarter to quarter.

annual_contracted_amount.description: Annual contracted amount C for the present-value method. The stream's value equals C times (1 minus 1.10 to the power of negative n), divided by 0.10, with n the remaining contract term in years; it glides to zero as the remaining term runs off. Zero when the multiple method or the dedicated-asset disposition applies.

ttm_amount.description: Trailing-twelve-month revenue for the multiple method, valued at the stream's quality multiple. Zero when the present-value method or the dedicated-asset disposition applies.

free_cash_flow.description: Trailing-twelve-month free cash flow; may be negative.

operating_expenses_monthly_avg.description: Trailing average monthly operating expenses; drives the 6-month working-capital floor.

computed.description: Outputs of the canonical formulas, recomputable by any party from Holder-tier inputs. The analyst is the formula.

ledger_base_per_fd_unit.description: Conversion price input: Ledger Base divided by fully diluted shares or units (fully_diluted_units). Where the Fixed Pool Schedule is elected, the dilution cap applies per position at conversion as a price floor: the conversion price is the greater of Ledger Base and three times the position's full remaining claim, divided by fully diluted shares. Where the Direct Ledger Schedule is elected, the price is Ledger Base per fully diluted share or unit, with no floor.

fully_diluted_units.description: Fully diluted shares or units: outstanding equity assuming exercise and conversion of all options, warrants, and convertible securities, including all shares or units reserved under equity incentive plans. A number rather than an integer, because units denominated in a standardized ledger unit of account may be fractional.

expected_capacity.description: min(0.25 x max(0, TTM FCF), max(0, cash minus working_capital_floor)), floored at zero.

declared_budget.description: The venture's decision for this quarter's settlement. Zero is valid and is not default.

variance_note.description: Required when declared_budget < expected_capacity; states why capital is being retained.

insider_positions_present.description: Insider-held positions participate pro rata and are flagged.

cash_settled.description: Paid in cash on a Buyout settled this quarter, as distinct from the amount noticed. Where the venture is a C corporation and a position is treated as stock under instrument Section 8(j)(i), this is a purchase by the Company of its own stock for Section 1202(c)(3) purposes.

other_repurchases.description: Every other purchase by the venture of its own equity settled this quarter, including repurchases from departing service providers at cost under instrument Section 7(a). Counts with queue.paid_this_quarter and buyout_notice.cash_settled toward the Section 1202(c)(3) test where the venture is a C corporation.

commentary.description: Brief management commentary. No PII, no customer or counterparty identities, no partner names, no pipeline detail.

owners_and_leaders_total_ttm.description: A single total of trailing-twelve-month compensation paid to owners and leaders (related parties and control persons) in aggregate. Aggregate only; never an individual breakdown. The one channel that can move value out of Expected Capacity unseen, kept visible.

attestation.description: Required only when meta.attestation_grade is 2 (enforced by the conditional rule below). The same Quarterly Update with an independent assurance wrapper; this is why the Standard is one schema, not two.

attestor.description: Identity of the independent third party attesting the Ledger Base computation.

procedures.description: Reference to the agreed-upon procedures or equivalent standard applied.

attestation_artifact_hash.description: Content hash of the signed attestation artifact, for provenance.

x-canonical-constants.description: The controlling numbers, mirrored here for machine use. The SAFR Reporting Standard spec is authoritative.

multiple_interpolation.fixed_pool: linear between anchors; never below 1.50; never exceeds 2.50; never decreases
multiple_interpolation.direct_ledger: linear between anchors; never below 1.00; never exceeds 1.60; never decreases

x-canonical-constants.qda_amortization_basis: per vintage: each month of qualifying development spend amortizes straight-line over its own 36 months; the asset is the sum over the trailing 36 months of each month's spend times max(0, 1 - age_in_months/36)
x-canonical-constants.max_conversion_ownership_note: applies where the fixed_pool Schedule is elected; under direct_ledger no cap and no price floor apply

x-versioning.scheme: semantic, MAJOR.MINOR within the pinned major version
x-versioning.minor: Refinements, calibration, added revenue-quality tags, and data-mapping improvements ship as minor versions and apply automatically to outstanding instruments.
x-versioning.major: A new major version is any change that would alter a previously issued position's computed Ledger Base, Expected Capacity, or claim value (the Unreturned Purchase Amount times the Multiple), each computed under that position's elected calibration, for any quarter, by more than major_version_materiality_threshold_pct (3.0%). Introducing or withdrawing a Schedule is a major version regardless of that test. A new major version applies to an outstanding instrument only with the Holder's and the Company's consent.
x-versioning.pinning: Each executed SAFR pins the major version and records the content hash of the Reporting Standard spec in effect at issuance.

x-conformance.calibration: Initial conformance is set by a qualified human analyst who calibrates each venture's data mapping to this Standard.
x-conformance.automation: Automated computation then applies the same weights to the same data, conforming to this Standard, so the automated result matches the calibrated baseline.
x-conformance.provider: Who serves the conformance role for a venture is stated in its Manifest (conformance_provider), never in this schema.
x-conformance.maturation: The conformance method is expected to refine with volume; refinements ship as minor versions.

x-vocabulary.visibility: The term 'public' is not used. Visibility is invitational, need-to-know transparency by the venture's standing grant; Venture Visibility is an invitation, not a listing.
x-vocabulary.quarterly_cycle: The instrument runs on fiscal quarters ending Mar 31, Jun 30, Sep 30, Dec 31. Holders elect at least 10 days before the quarter closes; the venture issues its Quarterly Update within 45 days after; settlement follows within 10 business days after the Update.
